records.title: Circle Internet Group Form 8-K — Binance commercial agreement and $100M private placement
records.note: Circle's SEC Form 8-K states that on 2026-09-17 subsidiaries entered a five-year USDC promotion arrangement with Binance tied to USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure. Circle agreed to pay Binance a monthly incentive fee; Binance agreed to promote USDC on its platform. Circle issued 1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 for $100M. Binance retained ordinary stockholder voting rights and agreed to a transfer/hedging restriction lasting up to two years, subject to exceptions. This is a direct equity and commercial relationship, not evidence Binance controls Circle.

records.title: Circle announcement — Binance invests $100M and renews five-year USDC agreement
records.note: Circle says Binance will promote USDC across its global platform, especially emerging markets, while Circle supplies infrastructure to hold/use USDC. The $100M equity investment accompanied the five-year commercial agreement. Company strategic framing; future adoption and incremental balances are not yet measured.

records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings release
records.note: Coinbase reports average USDC held in Coinbase products of $22B in Q3, up 49% YoY and roughly 30% of average USDC market capitalization. Coinbase says it captured approximately 50% of all USDC economics over the past year; this is a company-reported claim, not independently reconciled here. It reports 10.7% crypto trading-volume share, 12.5% assets-on-platform market share, 179% two-year CAGR in crypto derivatives volume, and prediction markets above $200M annualized revenue. Q3 net income includes $715M net gains on crypto assets held for investment; adjusted net income was $77.7M. Average USDC balance is a Coinbase-products metric, distinct from Circle's own platform metric.

records.title: SBI Group company profile — SBI Ripple Asia
records.note: SBI Group's current group-company page lists SBI Ripple Asia and states SBI Group holds 60% of its voting rights as of 2026-03-31. This confirms SBI's controlling voting interest at that date; it does not independently disclose or prove the remaining ownership percentage.

records.title: SBI Holdings investor presentation — Ripple and SBI Ripple Asia ownership
records.note: SBI's February 7, 2025 investor presentation states SBI Group held approximately 9% of Ripple based on actual holdings as its largest external shareholder and describes SBI Ripple Asia as established in May 2016 with SBI 60% and Ripple 40%. These are date-specific disclosures; the approximately 9% Ripple stake is historical and not a verified October 2026 cap table.

records.title: Circle Q2 2026 Form 10-Q — correction to USDC platform metric attribution
records.note: Correction to prior ledger wording: the Q2 10-Q's 19.5% daily weighted-average 'USDC on platform' and $12.442B end-of-period 'USDC on platform' refer to Circle's own platform, not Coinbase. Note 1579 defines Circle's platform as Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and non-custodial wallets offered through Circle. Coinbase's platform is separately referenced in the distribution-cost discussion. Circle's Q2 distribution costs in connection with Coinbase agreements were $324.6M Q2 and $655.3M H1; those are costs under the arrangement, not the 19.5% metric.

records.title: Circle Q3 2026 results webcast schedule
records.note: Circle scheduled its Q3 2026 results webcast for November 4, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET. Q3 Circle reserve yield, USDC circulation, Coinbase/Binance distribution economics and Circle SBI Japan JV operating results are not yet available at this cutoff.
